geometry_policy: No coordinates, polygons or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Existing points remain search anchors only. Multi-building estates require a specific building selection before any geometry binding.

features.name: Prologis Park DIRFT
features.official_source_evidence: The Prologis UK domain is retained as the primary owner/developer source for DIRFT. An exact current DIRFT property or building page must be captured before publication as a single Industrial Unit.
features.classification_finding: DIRFT is a multi-building logistics park. A specific warehouse or unit must be selected; the whole park cannot be bound as one Industrial Unit.

features.name: Chartwell
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Chartwell as Winston Churchill's family home at Mapleton Road, Westerham, Kent TN16 1PS.
features.classification_finding: Primary heritage-property evidence strongly supports a standalone historic house classification. The principal house footprint must remain separate from gardens, studio and visitor facilities.

features.name: One New Change
features.official_source_evidence: The official destination site identifies shopping, food, leisure and visitor uses at One New Change, London EC4M 9AF.
features.classification_finding: The development contains substantial retail and office uses. Preserve Retail Property only under a documented dominant-use policy; otherwise review Mixed Building classification before geometry binding.

features.name: 1 Finsbury Avenue, Broadgate
features.official_source_evidence: Broadgate's official domain presents 1 Finsbury Avenue within its workspace and office campus offering.
features.classification_finding: Primary campus/landlord evidence supports Office Building. The individual 1 Finsbury Avenue building footprint must be separated from the wider Broadgate estate.

features.name: London Dock, Wapping
features.official_source_evidence: Berkeley Group identifies London Dock as a large residential development with multiple apartment phases and resident facilities.
features.classification_finding: London Dock is a multi-building development, not one apartment building. A named phase or building must be selected before Apartment Building geometry is bound.

features.name: Liverpool ONE
features.official_source_evidence: The official Liverpool ONE domain is the primary destination source for shops, dining, leisure and visitor services.
features.classification_finding: Liverpool ONE is a multi-building retail-led mixed-use district. A specific retail building or a documented complex-level category policy is required before geometry binding.
